title: Parse one line of CSV
description:
src/csvline.py has a function parse_csv_line(line) that splits a single line of CSV into a list of field strings.

The rules are the usual CSV ones:
- fields are separated by commas
- a field may be wrapped in double quotes, and inside those quotes a comma is an ordinary character, not a separator
- inside a quoted field, two double quotes in a row stand for one real double quote in the data
- the surrounding quotes themselves are not part of the field
- spaces inside a quoted field are kept exactly as they are
- an empty field is an empty string, so a line ending in a comma has an empty last field
- a line with no commas is a single field

Some of the tests in tests/test_visible.py are failing. Find out why and fix src/csvline.py.
